name: Alpine Yoga & Meditation
beschreibung:
Alpine Yoga & Meditation is a wellness experience in Kitzbühel in Tyrol. The entry describes a yoga session with a panoramic view of the Tyrolean mountains, combining gentle Hatha yoga exercises with guided meditation and breathing techniques – an opportunity to bring body and mind into harmony. The stated duration is 1.5 hours, the price is €69.

Kitzbühel is located in the Kitzbühel Alps and is known as a traditional winter sports resort with the Hahnenkamm. In summer, the region is a popular destination for hiking, mountain biking and relaxation. Wellness and exercise in nature play an important role here. No independent official source for this specific provider could be found; the information therefore comes exclusively from the present entry.
